k: A black-market tech dealer
st: Burch tries to steal Hank Pym's lab to sell its quantum tech, and is arrested.

k: A judge of the Time Variance Authority
st: Judge Renslayer prunes Loki variants and hides that the TVA's own agents are variants.
Renslayer leaves the TVA to search for free will.
Renslayer joins Miss Minutes to hunt Victor Timely, then tries to seize the TVA.
A spellbound X-5 prunes Renslayer, and she wakes in the Void as Alioth closes in.

k: The TVA's cheerful cartoon clock
st: Miss Minutes guards He Who Remains' secrets and offers Loki and Sylvie a deal.
Miss Minutes helps Renslayer track Victor Timely to protect her creator's future.
Miss Minutes crushes Dox and her loyalists, then O.B.'s system reboot shuts her down.

k: The man behind the TVA, at the end of time
st: He Who Remains reveals he built the TVA to stop his variants' war, and Sylvie kills him.
Loki time-slips back to the Citadel, where He Who Remains explains the Loom before Sylvie kills him again.

k: A Loki variant hunting the TVA
st: Sylvie attacks TVA Minutemen and plants reset charges across the Sacred Timeline.
Sylvie kills He Who Remains, and the timeline branches into a multiverse.
Sylvie starts a quiet life in 1982 Oklahoma, then joins Loki's friends at the TVA as the Loom fails.

k: A TVA Hunter
st: B-15 hunts and arrests Loki variants for the TVA.
Sylvie shows B-15 her old life, and she turns on the TVA.
B-15 works with Mobius and Loki to keep the TVA and its timelines alive.
B-15 arrives at the TVA and takes Paradox into custody.

k: A storm-like creature in the Void
st: Alioth devours whatever is pruned into the Void, until Sylvie enchants it.
Alioth closes in on Renslayer after she wakes in the Void.
Alioth still prowls the Void when Deadpool and Wolverine are dumped there.

k: A Loki variant who leads an army of Lokis
st: In the Void, President Loki ambushes Kid Loki's crew, until the Lokis all betray each other in a brawl.

k: A nosy Westview neighbor called Agnes
st: Nosy neighbor Agnes turns out to be Agatha, a witch who wants Wanda's power.
Wanda beats Agatha and traps her in Westview as Agnes.
Freed from Wanda's spell by a teen, Agatha gathers a coven to walk the Witches' Road.
Agatha gives her life to Death to protect Billy, and comes back as a ghost.

k: Acting director of S.W.O.R.D.
st: Hayward rebuilds Vision's body as a weapon and lies about it.
Monica Rambeau exposes Hayward, and he is arrested.

k: S.W.O.R.D.'s rebuilt Vision
st: White Vision fights Vision, gets his memories back, and flies away.

k: Leader of the Flag Smashers
st: Karli, a super soldier, leads the Flag Smashers in raids on the GRC.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Karli is shot by Sharon Carter during the GRC fight and dies.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: Super soldiers who want a world without borders
st: The Flag Smashers rob supply depots and bomb a GRC building, and Nico dies at John Walker's hands.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Arrested after the fight in New York, the Flag Smashers die when their transport explodes.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: The government's new Captain America
st: Walker takes the serum and kills a Flag Smasher in public with the shield.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Stripped of the shield and his rank, Walker becomes U.S. Agent for Valentina.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Walker joins the team that saves New York and becomes the New Avengers.

k: The unseen boss of Madripoor
st: The Power Broker rules Madripoor's underworld and wants the super soldier serum back.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
The Power Broker turns out to be Sharon Carter, who wins a pardon and her old job back.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A hero who says he comes from another Earth
st: Quentin Beck fakes Elemental attacks with drones and illusions to take Iron Man's place.
Beck dies fighting Spider-Man in London, leaving a fake video that names Peter as Spider-Man.

k: Beck's drone operator
st: Riva runs Beck's drones and gets away with the footage from London.

k: A Department of Damage Control agent
st: Cleary questions Peter and his friends over Mysterio's death, until the charges are dropped.
Cleary sends Deever after Kamala, then relieves her of duty when she defies his order to stand down.
Cleary's Damage Control has Trevor Slattery spy on Simon Williams, an actor with hidden powers.

k: Leader of the Tracksuit Mafia
st: Maya hunts the Ronin who killed her father, which leads her to Clint Barton.
Maya learns her uncle ordered her father's death, and confronts him.
Back in Oklahoma, Maya defies Fisk, reconnects with her family, and breaks his hold on her.

k: Maya's friend and second in command
st: Kazi sides with the Kingpin against Maya, and she kills him on Christmas Eve.

k: Kate Bishop's mother, a security CEO
st: Eleanor runs Bishop Security while secretly working with the Kingpin.
Eleanor admits to killing Armand Duquesne III, and the police arrest her on Christmas Eve.

k: A New York gang that calls everyone bro
st: The Tracksuit Mafia hunts Clint and Kate across New York.
Clint and Kate beat the gang in the Christmas Eve battle at Rockefeller Center.

k: A Widow raised as Natasha's sister
st: Under Red Room mind control, Yelena kills a rogue Widow, until a red gas frees her.
At Natasha's grave, Valentina tells Yelena that Clint Barton killed her sister.
Yelena hunts Clint, believing he killed Natasha.
Yelena learns the truth about Natasha's death and lets Clint go.
Yelena takes Valentina's dirty jobs, then helps save New York with the team called the New Avengers.

k: A giant one-eyed monster
st: Gargantos chases America Chavez through New York, and Strange and Wong kill it.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: A Strange variant corrupted by the Darkhold
st: Sinister Strange caused the incursion that destroyed his universe, and Strange kills him to take his Darkhold.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: Earth-838's council of heroes
st: The Illuminati put Strange on trial for the danger he poses.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
The Scarlet Witch kills most of the Illuminati in their own headquarters.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: A Deviant who steals Eternal powers
st: Kro grows stronger by draining Eternal powers, and kills Gilgamesh.

k: An Eternal who can fly and fire laser beams
st: Ikaris led Ajak to her death and turns on the team to protect Tiamut's Emergence.
Ikaris cannot bring himself to kill Sersi and flies into the sun.

k: An Eternal who looks like a child forever
st: Sprite sides with Ikaris to let the Emergence happen.
Sersi turns Sprite human, as she has long wished.

k: The Celestial who made the Eternals
st: Arishem planted the Celestial Tiamut inside Earth to be born.
Arishem takes Sersi, Kingo and Phastos to judge whether humanity should live.

k: Master of the Ten Rings
st: Wenwu hunts his children for their mother's pendants.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Wenwu attacks Ta Lo to free the wife he hears behind its gate, and the Dweller-in-Darkness kills him.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A Ten Rings enforcer with a blade for an arm
st: Razor Fist hunts Shang-Chi in San Francisco and Macau.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Razor Fist fights the soul eaters beside Ta Lo's defenders.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A masked Ten Rings assassin
st: Death Dealer trained a young Shang-Chi to kill, and a soul eater kills him at Ta Lo.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A soul-eating monster sealed behind Ta Lo
st: The Dweller tricks Wenwu into opening its gate.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Great Protector kill the Dweller.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A cult leader who once served Khonshu
st: Harrow hunts for Ammit's tomb so she can judge people before they sin.
Moon Knight and Layla seal Ammit inside Harrow, and Jake Lockley kills him.

k: An Egyptian goddess who judges souls
st: Harrow frees Ammit, who starts judging the people of Cairo.
Khonshu and Taweret's avatars seal Ammit inside Harrow's body.

k: A wealthy collector of antiquities
st: Mogart turns on Marc and Layla over a sarcophagus, and his fate is unclear after Marc blacks out.

k: Widow of the monster hunter Ulysses
st: Verussa holds a hunt for the Bloodstone with a monster named Ted as the prey.
Verussa tries to shoot Elsa, and Ted burns her to death.

k: A grieving man with a god-killing sword
st: Gorr takes the Necrosword and murders gods across the universe.
Gorr reaches Eternity and wishes his daughter back to life, then dies.

k: King of the Greek gods in Omnipotence City
st: Zeus refuses to help against Gorr and tries to keep Thor and his friends prisoner.
Thor runs Zeus through with his own Thunderbolt, but he lives and sends Hercules after Thor.

k: The scientist who made Rocket
st: The High Evolutionary wants Rocket's brain back and wipes out his own Counter-Earth.
Rocket spares the beaten High Evolutionary, and the Guardians free the children and animals he caged.

k: A golden warrior made by the Sovereign
st: Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere to grab Rocket.
Adam saves Peter Quill in space and joins the new Guardians.

k: Head of security on the Orgoscope
st: Karja leads the Orgoscope's guards and fires on the Guardians when he sees through their disguises.

k: Leader of the ClanDestine
st: Najma and the ClanDestine push Kamala to open the Veil to their home dimension.
Najma stays behind to close the Veil and dies, asking Kamala to look after Kamran.

k: A Department of Damage Control agent
st: Deever leads Damage Control's hunt for Kamala and Kamran across Jersey City.

k: A rich tech bro who dates Jen
st: Todd, the troll HulkKing, has Intelligencia leak a video of Jen at an awards gala.
Todd injects himself with Jen's blood and is arrested after the fight.

k: An influencer with super strength
st: Titania smashes into Jen's courtroom, and She-Hulk knocks her out.
Titania sues to claim the She-Hulk name, and loses in court.
Titania turns up at the Intelligencia summit to fight Jen, and she is arrested.

k: Thugs with stolen Asgardian tools
st: The Wrecking Crew jumps Jen to take her blood, and she beats them.

k: A rich man in a frog-themed super suit
st: Leap-Frog kidnaps the designer of his faulty suit, until She-Hulk and Daredevil stop him and he is arrested.

k: A rogue Wakandan ruling ancient Crete
st: The Lion rules Crete like a god and raids for slaves with stolen Wakandan tech.
Noni beats the Lion in a duel, and he dies setting off a blast that destroys his stronghold.

k: King of the undersea nation of Talokan
st: Namor demands Wakanda find the scientist who built a vibranium detector.
Namor floods Wakanda's capital, and Queen Ramonda dies.
Shuri beats Namor and spares him, and they make a truce.

k: A Talokan warrior general
st: Attuma leads Talokan raids on the US and on Wakanda.

k: One of Namor's fiercest warriors
st: Namora fights Wakanda's forces at Namor's command.

k: A crime boss in a magic cloak
st: Parker Robbins wears a cloak of dark power and leads a heist crew in Chicago.
Riri tears the hood off Parker, and he goes to Zelma Stanton looking for magical help.

k: A devil who makes deals
st: Mephisto turns out to be the source of Parker's hood, and Riri takes his deal to bring back Natalie.

k: Leader of a Skrull rebellion
st: Gravik plants Skrull impostors to push humans toward war, and kills Talos.
Gravik becomes a Super Skrull with Avengers DNA, and G'iah kills him.

k: Gravik's second in command
st: Pagon carries out Gravik's orders, until Gravik kills him.

k: A Skrull posing as James Rhodes
st: Raava, posing as Rhodes, pushes President Ritson toward war.
Fury and Sonya Falsworth trap the impostor, and Fury shoots Raava dead.

k: Leader of the Kree
st: Dar-Benn uses a quantum band to tear open jump points and steal other worlds' resources.
Dar-Benn overloads herself with the band's power and is destroyed.

k: A Green Witch and Agatha's old flame
st: Rio hunts Agatha along the Witches' Road.
Rio turns out to be Death herself, and claims Agatha's life.

k: Spectral riders hunting Agatha
st: The Salem Seven ride after Agatha's coven as it starts down the Witches' Road.
Lilia turns a room upside down, and falling swords kill the Salem Seven.

k: Leader of the Serpent Society
st: Sidewinder's Serpent Society deals in stolen secrets and clashes with Sam Wilson.
Captured, Sidewinder names Samuel Sterns as the buyer in exchange for a lighter sentence.

k: A survivor of a secret super soldier trial
st: Bob becomes the Sentry, then the Void, swallowing New York in shadow.
The team reaches Bob inside his darkness, and he joins them as the New Avengers.

k: An exile trapped in the Quantum Realm
st: Kang rules part of the Quantum Realm and needs Janet's help to escape his exile.
Scott and Hope drive Kang into his own power core.

k: Countless variants of Kang
st: A vast council of Kang variants gathers to plan its next move.

k: A Quantum Realm noble who knew Janet
st: Lord Krylar welcomes Janet back, then tips off Kang's forces.

k: A 1901 inventor in Chicago
st: In 1901 Chicago, Victor Timely shows off his inventions as Loki and Mobius watch.
Victor tries to fix the Loom for the TVA, and its radiation tears him apart.

k: A TVA general
st: Dox prunes branched timelines with bombs until the TVA locks her up.
Dox refuses to join Renslayer, and Miss Minutes crushes her and her loyalists.

k: A TVA Hunter turned movie star
st: X-5 deserts the TVA to become movie star Brad Wolfe, until Loki and Mobius bring him in.
X-5 joins Renslayer's grab for the TVA, but Sylvie's spell makes him prune Renslayer.
After Loki saves the timelines, Brad Wolfe lives a new life on a branch timeline as a movie star.

k: Charles Xavier's twin sister, ruler of the Void
st: Cassandra rules the Void and plans to use Paradox's Time Ripper to end whole universes.
Cassandra dies in the Time Ripper's power surge.

k: A TVA agent with a Time Ripper
st: Paradox plans to erase Deadpool's universe with a Time Ripper.
B-15 arrives and takes Paradox into TVA custody.

k: A mysterious telepath
st: Jean Grey controls the Scorpion and the Hulk to strike at Damage Control over her sister Sara.
Spider-Man gets an inhibitor chip on Jean, and Metzger sedates her and locks her up.
When Peter takes a bullet meant for Jean, she keeps him alive with her mind and leaves on a bus.

k: Head of the Department of Damage Control
st: Metzger's Damage Control held telepath Sara Grey for experiments that killed her, and now holds Jean.
Metzger slips away in the chaos on Roosevelt Island.

k: A giant who devours worlds
st: Galactus comes to devour Earth and demands Sue's unborn son Franklin in exchange.
The Fantastic Four and the Silver Surfer force Galactus through a portal far from Earth.

k: Galactus's herald, Shalla-Bal
st: The Silver Surfer comes to Earth to announce Galactus is coming.
Johnny reaches Shalla-Bal, and she turns on Galactus to save Earth.
Shalla-Bal pushes Johnny aside and drives Galactus through the portal, vanishing with him.

k: Ruler of the world beneath the city
st: Mole Man, an old foe of the team, lets the city shelter in his tunnels from Galactus.

k: A tech genius who befriends Riri
st: Joe turns out to be Ezekiel Stane, Obadiah's son, and ends up in prison after turning on Riri.
Parker breaks Ezekiel out and controls his implants, until Riri frees him and he warns her they are not done.
